text:
marco: Heads up 5 minutes ago we got a customer report: their 2025-01 invoice shows two copies for the same period and one is missing embedding line items. Customer: Northwell Labs, ticket #BILL-7931.
billing-bot: Nightly invoice_reconcile run complete 2025-01-16T02:00:00Z. Alerts: duplicate invoice group detected for customer_id=NL-998, period=2025-01.
jin: Can you paste invoice numbers?
marco: INV-2025-4410 and INV-2025-4410-dup. Totals differ by $0.45. The original (INV-2025-4410) lacks embedding_line_items entirely.
riley: Quick triage 5 min: looked at invoice-generator logs. There's an intermittent DB transaction rollback on line_items flush triggered by connection timeout. The retry path created a second invoice record before the line items were attached. Logs: ```2025-01-15T23:59:59Z WARN invoice_service: flush_line_items timeout, rolling back
2025-01-15T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_service: retrying create; idempotency_key missing => new invoice id generated INV-2025-4410-dup```
marco: So duplication + missing items are correlated. Ops asks for a corrective script and a code fix.
ops-approval: Approve emergency remediation: void duplicate invoice and issue credit. Limit refund to $10k. Authorize immediate manual action.
riley: Running remediation script: `scripts/finance/void_and_credit.sh INV-2025-4410-dup "duplicate retry"`
riley: Done. Credit CR-2077 issued for $12,540.95 and invoice INV-2025-4410-dup set to void. Customer notified by CS.
marco: Please also reconcile usage so the correct invoice (INV-2025-4410) gets the missing embedding lines and updated total.
jin: Patch plan: add fallback idempotency key using sha1(customer_id + billing_period + checksum(usage_rows)) when request_id is null and ensure line_items write is atomic with invoice record (wrap in DB transaction with retry). I'll file PR and a hotfix.
ops-approval: Please include post-fix reconciliation run and an alert rule to detect invoices created within same 3-minute window for same customer+period.
marco: Ticket updated #BILL-7931 with actions, refund id, and PR link once available. Closing loop after hotfix + recon. :thumbsup:
